We value talented professionals who are eager to contribute to our organization, even when there may not be an immediate opening that matches their background.
If you believe your skills and experience could be an asset to ECS Financial Services, we encourage you to submit your resume for future consideration. Our team regularly reviews submitted applications and will reach out should an opportunity arise that aligns with your qualifications.
Thank you for considering ECS Financial Services as a potential employer; we appreciate your interest in joining our team.
Who We Are

At ECS, our mission is to deliver world-class services to our clients by combining the expertise of a large accounting firm with the personalized attention of a small business. Whether assisting the leasing industry or providing corporate and individual tax solutions, our team of professionals takes the time to truly listen and understand each client’s unique needs and goals.

As a full-service accounting firm recognized for our excellence in tax and portfolio management—especially within the leasing industry—we are proud to provide outstanding customer service to clients around the world.
We believe in supporting continuous professional growth, and many of our team members have earned CLFP and CPA credentials. Our 25-year membership with ELFA demonstrates our deep commitment to the leasing and financial services sector. In 2025, we were honored to be named one of Illinois’s Best Places to Work, a testament to our dedication to both our clients and our team.
